Produce a ready-to-use stub and a noisy WSL dry-run command; real downloading, reading ASDF header and building a physical halo history require a NEW separately preregistered future stage.

NERSC public 750TB subset can select small files, Constellation tape may bundle full base halos 6.6TB; trees may require browsing via Globus. Neither release DOI alone proves that exact merger tree of candidate box/phase is accessible.

At secondary z~.950 halo_info plus PID subsample only, actual z in ASDF header not directory; halo_info CompaSO L1 N and SO_radius, SODensityL1 epoch-specific relative cosmic mean, provider checksums.crc32 must be compared with GNU/POSIX cksum.

A single superslab halo_info_XXX.asdf and selected fields can be read to reduce IO; cleaned=True automatically reads auxiliary cleaning data and requires consistent tree product, no downloaded file exists yet. Full fields='all' can load additional progenitor data and is not an IO-free metadata operation.

2 BEFORE transfer: provider item size and available local space with margin recorded, permissions/Globus access established; do not transfer 6.6TB tar or ~75GB total halo_info by default.

3 ONLY after separate approved new stage: fetch just provider-listed necessary file(s), store exact size, GNU/POSIX cksum from official per-directory checksums.crc32 and local SHA256, no fake zlib checksum equivalence.
4 extract ACTUAL redshift, h, cosmology, particle mass/units, SO density reference species and threshold and any SO-radius sentinel flag from real ASDF header. Directory z0.950 is not actual z.
5 select raw or cleaned consistently for every tree node and verify original halo ID, progenitor/descendant across actual headers; raw DOI and cleaned DOI cannot be silently mixed.

6 validated provider-defined M200c at each actual epoch or properly supported full-particle incl field+periodic-padding remeasurement at 200rho_crit; L1 N*particle_mass, SO_radius, 10percent RV and secondary PID-only do not suffice.

7 independent cosmology As/tau and original F+/F- nonlinear neutrino wake comparison plus actual high-z LRG/ELG HOD/selection; halo merger tree alone cannot generate a physical galaxy finite-K bispectrum.
